name: How long does new weatherstripping typically last?

mainEntity.name: How long does new weatherstripping typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of new weatherstripping depends heavily on the material quality, exposure to elements, and the amount of wear and tear it experiences. High-quality rubber or metal weatherstripping can last 10 to 20 years or even longer with proper care. Less durable materials like foam or felt might only last a few years. Regular inspection and cleaning can help extend its life, but consistent exposure to extreme temperatures and frequent use will naturally shorten its effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: New weatherstripping lasts from a few years for foam to 10-20+ years for rubber or metal, depending on material quality and exposure.
